Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Ben Sombogaart's birth year as 1974 instead of 1947, despite contradictory information being available from a reliable source (Ask Oracle) that indicated his birth year as 1947. The Planner relied on the Wikipedia and IMDb pages that erroneously listed Sombogaart's birth year as 1974, without reconciling this discrepancy with the additional source. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Francis Lawrence was born earlier, when in fact Ben Sombogaart was born earlier in 1947.
